status: AMENDMENT written after (1) the first full M1 run over all 100 stills with the v1 detector (results/m1-raw-v1.json, kept), (2) the validation overlays of that run were looked at (rim ellipse on the rim and board quad on the white frame in every validation still that produced one; IMG_4844 had no rim near its seed in 8 of 10 stills because its camera moves), and (3) a unit test on a CLEAN DRAWN hoop that showed the v1 board lines wobble by about 2 degrees even when the geometry is perfect (the line search accepts any slope within a few pixels of the bar, and picks arbitrarily among near-ties). No validation METRIC (descriptor spread, gate outcome, class, false acceptance or rejection) had been computed when this was written, and no synthetic control had finished. It changes no threshold, tolerance, gate or criterion.

change.detector_v2: after the four board lines are chosen, each is refined by least squares to the centroid of the bar pixels along it (centroid across the bar at each position along the segment between the corners, inset 10 percent, one pass dropping points more than 2.5 px off the line), then the corners and the coverage are recomputed from the refined lines. The orange rim fit, the seed, the bands, the K=5 joint search and everything downstream are unchanged.
change.why: roll failed its gate on every dev clip (sd 1.1 to 2.3 degrees) and the same line wobble feeds az, off and asp. It is an implementation imprecision, shown on perfect geometry, not a property of the footage.
change.scope_of_evidence: v1 and v2 are BOTH reported: v1 on the committed raw file, v2 on every clip. The dev-clip tolerances and gate constants in criteria-v3.json were derived with v1 and are NOT re-derived: v2 is judged against the tolerances registered for v1. If v2 has a smaller spread this makes the tolerances conservative, which is stated; if larger, v2 loses. Validation clips were never used to tune anything; the only validation information used is that the v1 overlays looked right, so this refinement is not tuned to them.

unit_correction_noted: criteria.json writes u = sqrt(sd_a^2 + sd_b^2). The first synthetic output showed 'within' was unreachable with the per-still sd (delta + 2u > T even at delta 0). u is the uncertainty of the DIFFERENCE of two descriptor MEANS, i.e. each side's per-still spread divided by sqrt(n stills averaged). src/lib/framing/descriptor.ts now does this. The tolerances T (3 x pooled per-still sd) are unchanged. This is a correction of an implementation reading that contradicted the intent of 'repeat SD of each side', found on dev clip IMG_4839 before any validation class was computed.
synthetic_run_note: The first synthetic run was killed after 5 of 78 cells (it took about 40 s per cell) and will be redone with v2; its 5 cells (IMG_4839, P3) were comparable or unknown only because of the uncertainty bug above and are not reported.
